description:
Manage person files in people/. People are link targets for note.people and task assignees; they cannot be threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files, open only by default; QUERY is a fuzzy search that ranks by similarity
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file; PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md
  new [--name N] [--category C] — create a person file; prompts interactively for any field not supplied
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list: --all include closed people; --json JSON output.
  show: --json JSON output.
  new: --name FULL NAME; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary.
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]
  ["delete", "Old Contact", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any omitted field — always pass both --name and --category.
  `delete` is destructive and prompts unless -y is given.
  A person file must exist before that name can be used as a task assignee; `tasks set-assignee` exits 1 if it does not resolve.
